configure.title: PokeAPI address
configure.description: Leave as https://pokeapi.co/api/v2 unless you run your own copy of PokeAPI

configure.title: Mirror key
configure.description: Only for a self-hosted mirror that asks for one. PokeAPI itself needs no key. Stored on the server, sent only to the mirror

configure.title: Mirror key header
configure.description: The request header the mirror reads the key from

configure.title: Keep the Pokémon list for (hours)
configure.description: PokeAPI asks clients to cache. Searches use the stored list until it is this old
